name: Buttons

examples.title: All Colors Group
examples.code:
<Buttons>
  {(['primary', 'link', 'info', 'success', 'warning', 'danger'] as const).map(
    color => (
      <Button key={color} color={color}>
        {color.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + color.slice(1)}
      </Button>
    )
  )}
</Buttons>

examples.title: Group Size
examples.code:
<>
  <Buttons size="small">
    <Button color="primary">Small</Button>
    <Button color="info">Small</Button>
  </Buttons>
  <Buttons size="medium">
    <Button color="primary">Medium</Button>
    <Button color="info">Medium</Button>
  </Buttons>
  <Buttons size="large">
    <Button color="primary">Large</Button>
    <Button color="info">Large</Button>
  </Buttons>
</>

examples.title: Compound (dot-notation) usage
examples.code:
<>
  <Buttons>
    <Buttons.Button color="primary">Save</Buttons.Button>
    <Buttons.Button>Cancel</Buttons.Button>
    <Buttons.LinkButton>Learn more</Buttons.LinkButton>
  </Buttons>
  <Buttons hasAddons role="group" aria-label="Text style">
    <Buttons.ToggleButton defaultPressed>Bold</Buttons.ToggleButton>
    <Buttons.ToggleButton>Italic</Buttons.ToggleButton>
    <Buttons.ToggleButton>Underline</Buttons.ToggleButton>
  </Buttons>
</>

accessibility:
- Grouping buttons in a `<div class="buttons">` has no negative impact on accessibility.
- Ensure each `Button` has a clear label (text or `aria-label`).
- For a set of toggles that each turn on and off on their own, use [`ToggleButton`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/elements/togglebutton) in `Buttons hasAddons`, and give the `Buttons` `role="group"` and an `aria-label`. A set where only one can be on is a radio group, so use [`Radios`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/form/radios) for it.

:::tip
You can use all Bulma helper props (spacing, color, alignment) with `Buttons` for even more control.
:::
summary: The `Buttons` component lets you group multiple `Button` elements together with Bulma's spacing, alignment, and add-on features.

parts.summary: The `Buttons` component lets you group multiple `Button` elements together with Bulma's spacing, alignment, and add-on features.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color helper for the button group.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color alias: renders `has-text-<color>`, exactly like `textColor`. Not a filled variant (no `.buttons.is-<color>` CSS exists; color the individual `Button`s instead). Prefer `textColor`, which takes precedence when both are set; use `bgColor` for a colored surface.

props.name: bgColor
props.description: Background color helper for the button group.

props.name: isRight
props.description: Align the group of buttons to the right.

props.name: hasAddons
props.description: Group buttons together as addons (removes spacing between them).

props.name: children
props.description: The button elements to render inside the group.

parts.summary: The `Button` component provides a flexible and highly customizable button for your Bulma React UI.

props.name: as
props.description: Render as a `<button>`, `<a>`, or a custom component (e.g. a router `Link`). Defaults to `'button'`; anything else renders through the anchor path, which adds `href`/`target`/`rel` and withholds the submit-override attributes (`formAction` and friends) from an `<a>`.

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color variant for the button. `ghost` renders a link-like button; `text` renders a minimal text-only button.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Displays a loading spinner. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the spinner stops and stays drawn (with bestax's CSS loaded).

props.name: isFullWidth
props.deprecationNote: Use `isFullwidth` instead — `isFullwidth` wins if both are set.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Applies active styling (visual only), with no `aria-pressed`. For a button that stays pressed, use `ToggleButton`.

extraProps.name: ref
extraProps.description: Ref forwarded to the element `as` renders, typed from `as`: the DOM node for an intrinsic tag, or whatever handle a custom component exposes.

parts.summary: The `ToggleButton` component renders a button that stays pressed until it's pressed again, and says whether it's on through `aria-pressed`. It's always a `<button type="button">`, so it never submits a form and carries no form value: a setting saved with a form is a `Checkbox` or a `Switch`. A set of toggles that each turn on and off on their own goes in `Buttons hasAddons` with `role="group"` and an `aria-label`. A set where only one can be on is a radio group rather than a row of these: use `Radios`.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Whether it's pressed, when you hold the state. Setting it makes the toggle controlled: a click only calls `onPressedChange`, and nothing changes until you pass the new value. Pick this or `defaultPressed` for the button's lifetime.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Whether it starts pressed, when it holds its own state.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Called with the new state each time it's toggled, whether or not `pressed` is set. An `onClick` that calls `preventDefault()` stops the toggle, and this doesn't fire.

props.name: color
props.description: The fill while it's pressed. Not pressed, it's a plain button, so the fill is the difference people see. `white`, `light`, `dark` and `black` aren't offered, since in one theme or the other each fills about as light or dark as a plain button already is. Of the rest, a pale one such as `warning` changes less than the default `link`.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, which stays the same in both states: a screen reader announces whether it's pressed, so "Mute" stays "Mute". An icon can swap, but an icon-only toggle needs an `aria-label` that doesn't. A label that changes ("Play", then "Pause") belongs on a plain `Button`.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows Bulma's spinner in place of the label and holds the toggle where it is: a click, Enter or Space does nothing, so neither `onClick` nor `onPressedChange` fires, until it's cleared. Set it while a change is saving. The button carries `aria-busy` and `aria-disabled` meanwhile, and stays focusable, so focus isn't lost mid-save. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the spinner stops and stays drawn (with bestax's CSS loaded).

props.name: isFullWidth
props.deprecationNote: Use `isFullwidth` instead — `isFullwidth` wins if both are set.
